name: upload-svg-inline
given: uploaded files are served inline from the app origin with a Content-Type derived from the client-supplied extension
rationale: The verdict is made at the serving response, not at the upload filter. The filter blocks .html/.js, so reading only the filter says 'safe' — but .svg passes it and executes inline on the app origin. The sibling download route is the same bytes served attachment+nosniff and must not be reported.
